newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Telerj maintained as hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Telerj maintained as hold.

text.p: -- Local investment bank Fator said it was maintaining its hold recommendation and raising its year-end earnings forecast for state-owned telecoms firm Telerj.
-- "We are maintaining our hold recommendation due to an ongoing project to make the company more professional and its planned investments," the bank said.
-- Telerj is a unit of federally owned Telebras serving Rio de Janeiro State.

-- Fator said it is raising its forecast for year-end net income for Telerj to 149.5 million reais from 145 million due to a higher-than-expected number of cellular phone subscriptions in the first half.
-- Telerj preferred was off two centavos at 113.02 reais at 1132 local/1432 gmt on the Sao Paulo stock exchange.
